beats.narr: Sport's top court has ruled on January's Africa Cup of Nations final.
Senegal won it 1-0. In March that became a 3-0 defeat. Now it is 1-0 again.
Senegal's players had walked off in protest. They returned after 14 minutes.

n261124e.end: Rick has appealed. Expect a ruling in ten months.

n261124e.why: Senegal won the final 1-0 in Rabat on 18 January after walking off in protest at a penalty and returning. In March the confederation ruled that a forfeit and recorded a 3-0 win for Morocco.

beats.narr: In Michigan, a drone delivered a parcel of shampoo.
Leaving, it hit a cable and came down on the garage roof.
The damage: a few scuffed shingles. Neighbours lost their internet for a while.
Amazon gave the homeowner and some neighbours $100 gift cards.

n261124j.end: Gary's roof remains unhit. He has ordered shampoo.
n261124j.title: Point of order: it is on the roof
n261124j.claim: An Amazon delivery drone set down a parcel of shampoo in Huntington Woods, Michigan, then hit a cable as it climbed away and came down on the customer's garage roof.
n261124j.why: No injuries were reported and the homeowner called the roof damage very minor. Neighbours briefly lost their internet; Amazon retrieved the drone and gave out $100 gift cards.
